design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Obsessively Checking For New Leaves" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a person in profile leaning toward a potted plant, eyes wide and focused, one hand reaching toward a single leaf. The person wears casual clothing. Behind them, a large magnifying glass emphasizes the leaf detail. Composition: centered figure with plant, plain sage green background. Style: bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic, high contrast. Color palette: deep forest green, warm cream, rust brown, charcoal gray, solid color blocks only—no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
